note: Superseded collection attempts on the way to the published run. Each is retained with its actual failure; full raw directories are not committed. None produced a grade.

attempts.reason: The disposable App aborted before collection (SIGABRT, Avalonia RenderTimer error -6661): the desktop display was unavailable. Nothing was measured; the cause is the environment, not the suite.

The static-image suite completed but the animation observer refused its first request (diagnosed from the retained evidence and the fix: no animation frame was recorded): its prior-challenge allowance covered the input phase only, while the static-image phase adds 31 more pairs. Fixed in b8625ed5 with a regression test.

The animation suite reached its first build stage and refused the raw replies: the App acknowledged a=T with its placement id (i=<id>,p=1;OK) as the lifecycle contract documents, while the expected reply shape omitted it. The reply-format expectation was corrected in c9875876; no pixel result or grade was involved.
